note: Real 254/39 frames from the linked STREAM 5000 pair on issue #401 (2026-09-13, third diagnostics download, taken on v1.22.0-beta.6). Both connections carry f50 with two entries in this capture; unit_a (0166, ES21-d425) carries it only in the night frames around the 00:25 restart, unit_b (0085, ES21-c9c5) carries it in the day, in the app's get_reply frames and in a delta. Serials are rewritten by position per connection: entry 1 gets the connection owner's serial, entry 2 the neighbour's. Equal length, so every other byte is the device's own. Frames are kept whole, in capture order; `topic` is the MQTT topic the export recorded.
